_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The GitHub integration shows its repository from the details and copies its clone command. The VM has four integrations: gh (GitHub, whose help is "git clone https://github.int.example.test/owner/project.git", with the repository owner/project), llm, notify and reflection. The page's clipboard is a fake: what is copied lands in window.copiedIntegrationText. Call "details asked" returns the names whose details the page has asked for, in order, as JSON. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start. There should be exactly 4 ".integrations-name-btn". 2. Call "details asked": it must return []. 3. Select gh. 4. "The table" is ".integrations-gh-table". Its link (role "link") whose name contains "owner/project" should have the attribute href exactly "https://github.com/owner/project". 5. Click the table's button named "Copy". window.copiedIntegrationText should become exactly "git clone https://github.int.example.test/owner/project.git" (eval until it is). 6. ".integrations-guide" should be there without the attribute "open": exactly 1 ".integrations-guide:not([open])". 7. Call "details asked": it must return ["gh"]. 8. The modal should hold no element with role "tab" (count 0). 9. Focus the first ".integrations-tabs button" (eval .focus()) and press Enter: there should be exactly 4 ".integrations-name-btn".
